headline: AI Deepfake Scams Emerging! Chairman of the Taiwan Stock Exchange Also Impersonated; TWSE Responds | Finance | SETN.COM
summary: The Taiwan Stock Exchange said scammers on LINE, Facebook and messaging apps have impersonated its chairman using AI deepfake images, audio and video to promote investment schemes.
why: The Taiwan Stock Exchange operates the island's main equity market, so impersonation scams targeting its leadership can mislead retail investors.
